_comment: Pinned snapshot digests (the assumeutxo parameters). A consumer accepts a snapshot only if the Bend-computed state digest equals the digest pinned here for that (height, hash). Each value must come from a genesis-synced instance (confirm.py --pin-only H --pack, or produce.py on that instance at its committed tip) and be reviewed like any consensus constant.

main.source: genesis-synced node, Bend-verified, produced 2026-10-27 (node/state: checkpoint sync from genesis to 3,522,460 and full validation above; produce.py at its committed tip in one read-only SQLite transaction while the node kept running; trees in Bend from its own leaf logs, ptree.py, continuity 287/287 Sapling and 180/180 Orchard; digest in Bend)

NOT PRODUCED: the genesis instance passed this checkpoint before anyone captured its state there. By 2026-10-27 it was ~10,000 blocks past it, beyond confirm.py's 600-block rollback fallback (store.UNDO_DEPTH), so its state at 3,522,460 cannot be reproduced without a new sync from genesis. No snapshot at this height is accepted.
